# Fine Jewellery Buyers

> UK-based buyer of gold, silver, platinum, diamonds, gemstones, luxury watches and designer jewellery. In-person valuations at Hatton Garden, London, and insured postal service across the United Kingdom. Free valuations with no obligation to sell.

Fine Jewellery Buyers (FJB) is a Hatton Garden jewellery store that purchases precious metals and fine jewellery from the public. Prices for gold and silver are linked to live market rates shown on the website. Customers may visit the showroom, book an appointment, request an online valuation, or use the gold calculator for an estimate.

We accept scrap gold, hallmarked and unhallmarked items, certified and uncertified diamonds, luxury watches (with or without box and papers), and designer brands including Cartier, Tiffany & Co., Boodles, Van Cleef & Arpels, Bulgari and Chopard.

## Services

- [Sell Gold](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-gold): Scrap gold, jewellery, bars and coins — 9ct to 24ct at live market-linked rates
- [Sell Diamonds](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-diamonds): Certified, uncertified and loose diamonds; diamond-set jewellery
- [Sell Gemstones](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-gemstones): Rubies, sapphires, emeralds and other precious gemstones
- [Sell Watches](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-watches): Luxury watches including Rolex, Omega, Cartier and Patek Philippe
- [Sell Jewellery](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-jewellery): Designer and branded fine jewellery above scrap-metal value where authenticated
- [Sell Silver](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-silver): Sterling silver jewellery, silverware, bars and coins
- [Sell Platinum](https://www.finejewellerybuyers.co.uk/services/sell-platinum): Platinum and palladium rings, jewellery and bars

## What We Do Not Do

- We do not sell or retail jewellery to the public; we buy items from customers only
- We do not offer pawnbroking or loans secured against jewellery
- We do not provide jewellery repair, resizing, custom design or manufacturing
- We do not buy costume jewellery, fashion watches or non-precious materials
- We do not provide investment, tax or legal advice; valuations are for purchase purposes only
- We do not operate retail stores outside Hatton Garden, London (postal service covers the wider UK)

## Locations

- **Showroom:** 88–90 Hatton Garden, London EC1N 8AA, United Kingdom (Hatton Garden jewellery district)
